description: Links an unlinked email to a conversation, as the inbox's Link does: email_id is the unlinked email, conversation_id the thread it belongs to (read conversations). The email's contact follows the thread's own contact. An email already on another thread is refused here; who its sender really is moves with move_address_to_contact. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat answers that it is already linked.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: link_email_to_conversation
title: Put an email on the right conversation
